data.long_description:
11,718 sq ft BUA on a 6,262 sq ft plot.

5 bedrooms + family room (convertible to a 6th bedroom), basement level, roof terraces, and internal courtyards.

• Private elevator (basement to roof)
• Basement with car lift and multipurpose space (gym/cinema/office)
• Bali-style overflow pool with counter-current system
• Expansive roof terraces overlooking the Burj Khalifa and Crystal Lagoon
• Direct private gate access to the lagoon promenade
• Parking for up to 10 cars

Fully upgraded with Italian finishes, Siemens kitchen appliances, Daikin VRV air-conditioning system, solar power integration, advanced home automation, whole-house water filtration, and premium landscaping.

A statement villa designed for end-users seeking scale, privacy, technology, and panoramic views in a single address.
